scripts.build: cd packages/tui && bun run build && cd ../ai && bun run build && cd ../agent && bun run build && cd ../coding-agent && bun run build
scripts.build:pi: cd packages/tui && bun run build && cd ../ai && bun run build:local && cd ../agent && bun run build && cd ../coding-agent && bun run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && bun run check:pinned-deps && bun run check:ts-imports && tsgo --noEmit && bun run check:browser-smoke
scripts.install:local-pi: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build:pi && bun link --cwd packages/coding-agent && bun add --global @redthing1/pi-coding-agent@link:@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
scripts.version:patch: bun scripts/bump-version.mjs patch && bun scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install --lockfile-only
scripts.version:minor: bun scripts/bump-version.mjs minor && bun scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install --lockfile-only
scripts.version:major: bun scripts/bump-version.mjs major && bun scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install --lockfile-only
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run check
